lines.text: A client for the notes service.
## Topics
### Creating notes
- ``create(title:body:options:)``
- ``create(contentsOf:options:)``
Creates a client for the notes service.
- Parameters:
- url: The URL of the notes service.
- configuration: How the client behaves.
Creates a note with a title and a body.
The note is stored at once. See ``Note/id`` for how a note is named, and
<doc:GettingStarted> for a walk-through.
- Warning: A title longer than 100 characters is cut off.
```swift
let note = try await client.create(title: "Hello", body: "World")
The service answers with the stored note:
```json
{ "id": "6f1c", "title": "Hello" }
- Parameters:
- title: The title of the note.
- body: The text of the note. ``CreateOptions/channel``
does not apply to it.
- options: How the note is created.
- Returns: The stored note, with the ``Note/id`` the service gave it.
- Throws: ``NotesError`` when the service rejects the note.
`CancellationError` when the task is cancelled.
Creates a note from a file.
- Parameter fileURL: The file to read the note from.
- Parameter options: How the note is created.
- Returns: The stored note.
Deletes a note.
- Parameter id: The ``Note/id`` of the note to delete.
Deletes a note.
Deletes a note.
Lists notes, a page at a time.
- Parameter page: The page of notes to return.
- Returns: The notes on the page.
Moves a note out of sight without deleting it.
- Parameter note: The note to archive.
- Returns: The archived note.
Adds tags to a note.
```swift
client.tag(note, with: "work", "urgent")
```swift
client.tag(note, with: "home", separator: " / ") { done in
print(done)
- Parameters:
- note: The note to tag.
- tags: The tags to add.
- separator: The text between two tags in the stored note.
- onProgress: Called with the share of tags stored so far.

Matches only notes where `column` equals `value`.
- Parameters:
- column: The column to filter on.
- value: The value to compare against.
- Returns: The same query, so calls can be chained.
Shares a note with other people.
Each person gets a link to the note. The link stops working when the note is deleted
with ``NotesClient/delete(withID:)``. See <doc:Sharing> for who may share a note.
- Warning: Anyone who has the link can read the note.
```swift
let link = try await client.share(noteWithID: note.id, with: "ada@example.com")
The service answers with the link:
```json
{ "url": "https://notes.example.com/s/6f1c" }
- Parameters:
- id: The ``Note/id`` of the note to share.
- people: The email addresses of the people to share the note with.
- options: What the people may do, and what they are told. A message
longer than 500 characters is cut off.
- Returns: The link that opens the note.
- Throws: ``NotesError`` when the service rejects the request.
`CancellationError` when the task is cancelled.
How a note is shared.
Whether the people may change the note.
A message to send along with the link. When `nil`, no message is sent.
Creates share options.
- Parameters:
- canEdit: Whether the people may change the note.
- message: A message to send along with the link.
